  certainty asserted

  certainty asserted

  relation "want delivery by"
  role subject "the Lugoj hospital"
  role object "40 cartons of insulin glargine pens"
  role time "Wednesday at the latest"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "can drop in"
  role subject "the carrier"
  role object "Timisoara or Arad"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "can drop in both"
  role subject "the carrier"
  role object "Timisoara and Arad"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "have a cold room"
    role subject "the Timisoara warehouse"
    polarity affirmed
  end
